# 皮克敏手游「中国台湾」争议与个资疑虑 引发台湾玩家退坑潮

知名手游皮克敏《Pikmin Bloom》 在台湾掀起一股散步种花、打菇风潮的旋风。但日前因其官方简体中文公告将台湾矮化为「中国台湾」，以及游戏需要使用GPS定位，引发个资隐私疑虑，遭到台湾玩家抵制。

发表时间： 21/11/2026 - 11:53

 5 分钟 浏览时间

 档案图片：知名手游皮克敏《Pikmin Bloom》2025年5月上线宣传。 © AP/Business Wire

 作者： [台北特约记者 陈筱涵](https://www.rfi.fr/cn/%E4%BD%9C%E8%80%85/%E5%8F%B0%E5%8C%97%E7%89%B9%E7%BA%A6%E8%AE%B0%E8%80%85-%E9%99%88%E7%AD%B1%E6%B6%B5/ "台北特约记者 陈筱涵")

广告

继续浏览后续

知名手游皮克敏《Pikmin Bloom》 2026年在台湾掀起一股散步种花、打菇风潮的旋风。但日前因其官方简体中文公告将台湾矮化为「中国台湾」，以及游戏需要使用GPS定位，引发个资隐私疑虑，遭到台湾玩家抵制，甚至有许多玩家干脆删除帐号。

争议爆发后，皮克敏官方在20日声明中，特别强调「台湾玩家」，并指出会保护玩家隐私与个人资料，且资料仅储存在美国的伺服器上，也不会改变既有的资料管理原则。不过皮克敏并未针对「中国台湾」一事正面回应。

知名财经记者胡采苹表示，皮克敏有超过一半的营收52%来自台湾，是全球最大市场，且光是课金总额就逼近6亿元。如果是为了钱舔中也说不过去，让许多玩家表示，没道理花钱还要受窝囊气。

据媒体报导，皮克敏最初是由任天堂授权、美国Niantic开发营运。不过2025年Niantic出售游戏业务，皮克敏转由美国Scopely接手。而Scopely于2026年投资中国游戏开发商Bokura，中国腾讯也是Bokura的股东之一，这层关联也让不少网友担心个资会被卖到中国。

并且皮克敏是款高度仰赖 GPS 定位的游戏，玩家日常散步、种花的过程都涉及位置资讯，因此有人质疑这些定位资料是否可能被传送至中国企业或相关单位。

且官方此次虽说明资料储存地点，但并未进一步交代资料存取权限、跨境处理机制及第三方服务供应商的具体安排。因此并不代表所有资料处理与存取行为都仅限于美国。

事实上，这也不是第一次有手游因为「中国台湾」字样而引争议。恋爱手游《恋与深空》人气角色「祁煜」来台庆生，原本粉丝要在西门町租下看板庆生，却因为文案出现「中国台湾」字眼引热议。甚至有玩家点名民意代表介入调查，要求审核单位给交代，让单纯的游戏应援彻底变调。

content:
23岁的颜欣慧（图）在受访时侃侃而谈，现场也有不少孩童举手向她提问。 （陈渊庄摄）
我国著名长距离泳将颜欣慧即将出征12月1日至6日的北京短池游泳世锦赛。她星期六（11月21日）出席交流会时说，有机会冲击世锦赛前八名，但竞争会很激烈。
新加坡泳联与马自达（Mazda）当日在电动汽车展厅联办交流会。23岁的颜欣慧提到，据她了解，这届世锦赛的决赛名额增至10个，每个国家每项最多可派三人，以往是两人。
颜欣慧（拿麦克风者）在马自达电动车展厅参加交流会，现场观众都聚精会神地聆听她的分享。（陈渊庄摄）
本赛季颜欣慧状态火热，她9月在爱知—名古屋亚运会上连夺400米、800米和1500米自由泳三枚银牌，并在三项都刷新全国纪录。
10月分别在哈萨克斯坦、乌兹别克斯坦和阿塞拜疆举行的三站世界杯中，她又夺得三金，并在哈萨克斯坦阿斯塔纳打破女子1500米自由泳亚洲短池纪录，把中国名将李冰洁保持的15分41秒80亚洲纪录缩短3秒39。
不过，她笑称自己只当了11天的亚洲纪录保持者，因为李冰洁随后便在北京举行的全国短池锦标赛以15分34秒09夺金，比颜欣慧创下的15分38秒41快了4秒32，收回纪录。此番颜欣慧做客北京，正是李冰洁的主场。
对于中国之行，她说这次的位置不同于往常：“我刚结束高强度的比赛，已经休息过了，这次更像是赛季初，重新找回比赛的感觉，享受现场的氛围。”
不少媒体已把她和李冰洁相提并论。颜欣慧说，两人在亚运会后熟络起来，而且因为都会说华语，她就用华语和对方聊天，当时李冰洁还有些意外。“每次在检录处看到她，都觉得安心。下水的时候我们当然在比赛，但池外我们还是朋友。”
颜欣慧（前）在亚运会的女子400米自由泳决赛获得亚军，中国名将李冰洁（蓝衣）以4秒10的优势夺冠。（邝启聪摄）
回到赛场，短池对颜欣慧来说并不陌生。2024年的布达佩斯世界短池锦标赛上，颜欣慧在出战的四个项目全部打破全国纪录。不过，她也说，亚运会之前的几个月自己没有游过短池，今年转战短池是个学习的过程，并非一路破个人最佳，有起有落。
她认为，25米池把细节放大，尤其是池壁，转身动作在整段泳程中的占比比长池大得多，每个池壁多犹豫一下，60趟下来就会累积。
颜欣慧（图）认为，短池比赛的转身动作数量比长池多很多，更加考验泳手的精细动作。（路透社）
赛程密集也是另一考验。从亚运会到三站世界杯，连续四周的比赛让她意外出现心理疲劳。她对《联合早报》感慨道：“到了第二、第三站时，我没想到会这么累。”但各国泳手都在同一条船上，吃饭时互相打气，对手也不例外”，她形容这是“最关键的因素之一”。
洛杉矶奥运方面，她透露自己已游进达标时间，只是成绩出现在达标期之外。她说，这是过去两个奥运周期里她第一次游进A标，此前一直是B标。下一个达标期明年3月开启，至2028年6月结束。谈到奥运资格，她说：“肯定不容易，但做得到。”
颜欣慧当日也和到场参加活动的孩童和家长交流，耐心地为他们签名并合影留念。她说，国人对她的期望也是她的前进动力，她希望多回馈社区。
颜欣慧的母亲李翠玲（左）和父亲颜宗义（右）也到场参加活动，为女儿捧场。（陈渊庄摄）

（中央社台北21日電）中國紀錄片導演、獨立電影策展人朱日坤策劃的第二屆Indie China電影節近日在紐約閉幕。據報導，電影節登場前，中國學者艾曉明受到壓力，其2部影片因此被迫取消展映。
據香港明報網20日消息，Indie China電影節15日在紐約一處藝術空間閉幕。電影節舉辦前，包括艾曉明在內、來自中國國內參加影展的相關人士及其家人、親友分別接到政府部門的「提醒」。
報導說，影展開幕前1個月，一批電影節周邊產品在中國境內運輸途中被當作「違禁品」扣留。艾曉明2次受到壓力，最終發出電郵請朱日坤撤下「致敬艾曉明」單元的2部影片「太石村」及「天堂花園」，相關部門甚至要求在有關演講中刪去艾曉明的名字。
另據報導，中國警方一再騷擾朱日坤的父母和弟弟們；演講來賓李思磐在中國國內家人也同樣被施壓，要求勸說李思磐取消活動。
此外，一些自稱代表「一群居住在紐約的海外華人」的人士向電影節2個場地公開的員工電郵信箱發出電郵，對電影節「表示強烈反對」，並稱入選展映的「所謂獨立電影」歪曲了中國社會的現實，既不客觀也不公正。電郵稱將繼續表達異議，直到活動取消或偏頗內容刪除為止。
朱日坤自2001年開始投身獨立影像運動；2003年起曾在中國組織策劃中國紀錄片交流週、北京獨立影像展，參與組織酷兒影展、同性戀文化節等活動；2014年伴隨家人移居美國。
73歲的艾曉明退休前任教於廣州中山大學，2003年創立中山大學性別教育論壇專案，隔年創辦中山大學性別教育論壇影像工作室，工作室宗旨是運用新媒體技術製作有關公民、特別是婦女維權的紀錄片，以支持變革中的公民行動。
艾曉明的紀錄片作品有「天堂花園」、「太石村」、「中原紀事」、「關愛之家」、「開往家鄉的列車」等，其中「關愛之家」獲2008年香港華語紀錄片節長片組亞軍；「太石村」、「中原紀事」、「關愛之家」入選2008年法國巴黎SHADOW中國獨立影像展；「開往家鄉的列車」入選2009年北京首屆打工者藝術節、2009年香港華語紀錄片節和香港第六屆社會運動紀錄片展。
報導稱，2025年的首屆Indie China電影節，相關導演曾受中國警方威脅，45部影片中約40部在導演要求下撤片。（編輯：周慧盈/朱建陵）1151121

title: 被指大外宣 網紅李子柒任四川文聯副主席
summary: 網紅李子柒獲任四川省文聯副主席，引發關注。（網路截圖） 【大紀元2026年11月21日訊】（大紀元記者唐兵綜合報導）中共官方通報，網紅李子柒「當選」四川省文聯副主席。李子柒因在YouTube開設帳號展現農村生活等走紅海外，但被認為是中共大外宣的一部分。 四川文藝網11月20日消息，11月19日至20日在成都舉行的四川省文學藝術界聯合會第九次代表大會，產生了新一屆主席團，陳智林任主席，王川、王飛、王迅、王道義、田捷硯、白浩、李樹、李鵬、李子柒、李延浩、張榮、張旭東、羅偉章、韓梅
content:
網紅李子柒獲任四川省文聯副主席，引發關注。（網路截圖）
【大紀元2026年11月21日訊】（大紀元記者唐兵綜合報導）中共官方通報，網紅李子柒「當選」四川省文聯副主席。李子柒因在YouTube開設帳號展現農村生活等走紅海外，但被認為是中共大外宣的一部分。
四川文藝網11月20日消息，11月19日至20日在成都舉行的四川省文學藝術界聯合會第九次代表大會，產生了新一屆主席團，陳智林任主席，王川、王飛、王迅、王道義、田捷硯、白浩、李樹、李鵬、李子柒、李延浩、張榮、張旭東、羅偉章、韓梅、童榮華、寒露任副主席，仲曉玲為主席團祕書長。
公開資料顯示，李子柒本名李佳佳，1990年出生於四川省綿陽市，是中國網絡短視頻創作者。她從2015年開始拍攝並製作美食主題的短視頻，2016年初起轉戰微博，之後還在海外視頻網站YouTube開設帳號，走紅海外。
2017年，微念公司和李子柒合資成立子柒文化，但2021年，李子柒與微念發生利益糾紛，李子柒的工作被迫暫停，直到2022年底，雙方才達成和解。2024年11月，李子柒復出。
李子柒有一連串官方頭銜，如「非物質文化遺產推廣大使」「上海世界技能大賽推廣大使」「中國農村青年致富帶頭人推廣大使」「中國農民豐收節推廣大使」，以及2019年年度文化傳播人物，等等。
新華網、央視等中共官媒曾宣傳李子柒，聲稱這是講好「中國故事」的成功案例。
不少網評人士認為，李子柒的走紅，背後有中共官方的支持。她的視頻拍攝和製作顯然是由非常專業的製作團隊完成的，這並非普通視頻博主所具備的能力。
資深媒體人唐浩曾在其自媒體頻道《世界十字路口》中談到，眾所周知，YouTube在中國是被禁止的，而李子柒以及一些外宣頻道能夠在YouTube高調地經營，是因為背後有官方支持。
唐浩認為，李子柒的視頻表現的是人民的生活與中國的傳統文化，而且往往是刻意篩選過的、精緻化的美麗片段，會讓海外觀眾產生一種「嚮往中國」「認同中國」的潛意識。
他表示，李子柒一直被許多人認為是中共大外宣的一部分。中共當局希望通過這些網紅視頻「借船出海」，在海外以柔性方式消解「中共威脅論」。這是中共在盜用中華傳統文化的「軟實力」，以降低人們對中共的戒心，混淆人民對「中國不等於中共」的認知。

content:
Fundraiser by Su Lee : Wipe Away Su Lee's Tears from her Composing Nights
Su Lee is organizing this fundraiser.
Dear friends, music lovers, and new music supporters,
It’s me, Su Lee, and I am currently working on my dissertation concert (for my Ph.D. in composition) which will be held on Sept. 9th 2019 Monday at 7:30pm in Lippes Concert Hall in Slee Hall at University at Buffalo.
The title of my dissertation composition and concert is Die Radikalen Tasten (The Radical Keys) in terms of aesthetics, Klang (sound), and theme.
I am writing a concerto for organ with keyboard ensemble, namely for our own tremendous Fisk Op.95 organ at UB. It will involve organ soloist with 1 assistant, 2 pianos (1 quarter-tone flat piano), 2 harpsichords (1 quarter-tone flat harpsichord), and 2 vibraphones which is a very rare instrumentation for microtonal new music.
The 1st half of the program features significant keyboard works from the 20th century such as Messiaen's solo organ work and Ives's quarter-tone piano pieces. As a special request from Dr. Fuller, who was in charge of the installation of the Fisk Op.95 organ at UB, I'm playing my very first organ transcription of Wagner's orchestral work.
The 2nd half of the program features my own 'radical' politically inspired compositions including a choral piece with organ accompaniment (dedicated to the UUCB Choir family) and my dissertation organ concerto. Both works are based on the Korean Democratic Uprising in May 1980 and the protest song written for the victims of the subsequent Gwangju massacre - a song that has became widely popular for activists and protesters, including those participating in the on-going Hong Kong protests.
Overall, it is a very colorful and unique combination and a rare program which is a you-don’t-want-to-miss concert.
I am modestly asking you for a little or big help in making my dissertation concert happen smoothly, especially given my financial struggles in not being able to even work legally for money off campus in America due to my visa status.
Your generous donation will be spent towards, (besides helping me wipe away all my tears and whining from composing numerous nights over the past few months and rehearsing in the upcoming days and nights):
Nine Musicians’ Performance Fee, about $3,000 – 3,300
Rent/Labor for Lippes Concert Hall in Slee Hall, about $1,000
Other concert related costs; buying performing materials, copying/binding score/parts, printing poster/program book, audio/video recording, photographing, tuning, reception, etc. about $1,200 – 1,500
Fortunately, I got awarded the MDRF (research fund) for $3,000 at UB so that I can be reimbursed afterwards, but I need money upfront now to pay first, and possibly more, to pay my dream team musicians fairly and to cover other costs.
Your genuine help means SO MUCH to me being an international Ph.D. student with many restrictions on earning money (3 months summer break without job, seriously!), as it will lighten my financial burdens and psychological anxiety when I absolutely need to focus more on my creative activities.
Simply speaking, you are contributing to a potentially "fabulous" new music piece, stimulating my further musical activities and making me believe that life (and the world) is so beautiful!
Every single one of your names will be acknowledged in my concert program book, and to thank you all, but not nearly enough, I like to give you in return as below:
$1~$49: a thank-you-card with a cover of a handwritten excerpt of my score
$50~$99: a thank-you-card like above AND a dvd of my dissertation concert (after my concert)
$100~$199: a thank-you-card AND a dvd like above, PLUS the autographed full score of my dissertation composition
$200~$299: EVERYTHING above AND one additional dvd of my Masters organ recitals (your choice of “Über den Namen B-A-C-H” or “Celebrating Lou Harrison’s 100th Birth-Year at Thunder Night”)
$300 or more: EVERYTHING above, PLUS a gift pack of Korean snacks/sweets/tea etc.
Please write me an email with your home address!
I am really excited to prepare my dissertation concert. Though I feel like this is sadly going to be my last self designed concert during my time in Buffalo (at UB), so I cannot wait to see many of you there!
Thank you so much for reading this and considering your donation.
I promise to pay you back with my "fabulous" new compositions and my performance, with the great help of my dream team of musician fellows!
Please feel free to spread the link to your social pages like Facebook, Instagram, or Twitter, or to emails, to help get the word out!
FYI, I am collecting your donations from now till October and GoFundMe takes 2.9% for transaction fee plus $0.30 PER Donation. Or you can donate by sending me a check to my place (email me for asking my address please!)

summary: Fundraiser by tyrone thomas : Unite for Digital Fearlessness tyrone thomas is organizing this fundraiser. "Use what's in your hand" - Adam Clayton Powell Jr. Your phone isn't just for posting stories and playing music. That little computer
content:
Fundraiser by tyrone thomas : Unite for Digital Fearlessness
tyrone thomas is organizing this fundraiser.
"Use what's in your hand" - Adam Clayton Powell Jr.
Your phone isn't just for posting stories and playing music. That little computer in your pocket has more power than entire governments had 20 years ago. Like the ancient Abhaya Mudra - the fearless hand gesture that banishes fear and offers protection from the "Evil Eye" - we're transforming these devices into something that helps communities meet the coming challenges with a sense of fearlessness, rooted in Free Collaboration and Privacy.
Abhaya started as disaster recovery - how do communities rebuild communication when the towers are down and the power's out? But we realized something profound: the same tools that help neighborhoods coordinate after a hurricane are exactly what we need when authoritarians try to silence us. Like the protective Abhaya Mudra, this system creates a shield against the "evil eye" of surveillance while becoming a helpful digital companion that guides and empowers our communities.
Drawing inspiration from Buckminster Fuller's vision of global cooperation for humanity's benefit, Abhaya is designed as the foundation for communities to work together toward a more equitable future. The ecosystem operates through five interconnected elements:
• Tor + Mobile based Mesh Networks: Messages that flow around censorship like water
• Mesh Based Distributed Storage: Truth that lives everywhere so it can't be destroyed
• Mesh Based Distributed Computation Service: AI-capable shared processing power for communities to solve their own challenges
• Sensor/Peripheral IO: User Controlled Eyes and ears embedded in the network
• Mesh Federation: Connecting local networks into unstoppable global resistance
"The ultimate measure of a man is not where he stands in moments of comfort and convenience, but where he stands at times of challenge and controversy." - MLK Jr.
After Hurricane Katrina, communities learned they couldn't wait for official help. Hong Kong protesters used mesh networks when the government tried to cut them off. Iranian women shared videos of police brutality when the state blocked social media. Puerto Ricans coordinated mutual aid through amateur radio when Maria destroyed the grid.
The pattern is clear: when systems fail - whether from natural disasters or deliberate suppression - communities need tools to build their own infrastructure. Communities united in purpose and vision can be powerful.
When you contribute to Abhaya, you're investing in infrastructure that makes communities fearless. No CEO can sell it. No government can buy it. No algorithm can suppress it. No storm can wash it away.
Every dollar helps us turn individual devices into collective power. Like Powell said - we're not waiting for someone to save us. We're using what's already in our hands to build the infrastructure of fearlessness.
Fund the network that makes communities fearless.
We're assembling an international team of developers and engineers who understand that code is power, and power should belong to the people. If you're a technologist looking to put your skills toward meaningful resistance, this is how you push back against authoritarianism and corporate overreach.
• Onion Router, I2P, Freenet protocols
• DevOps/SecOps fluent in Dark Web technologies
This is open-source work with no revenue model - Abhaya is designed to be free for all communities. For technologists feeling the weight of current events, it's a concrete way to turn skills into direct action and fulfill civic duty through code. Ready to put your shoulder to the wheel of progress? Reach out.
Because true community care means building the infrastructure that makes us all fearless.

日本首相高市早苗（前右）18日搭乘政府專機抵達中國深圳，高市走下飛機時，機艙出口與舷梯之間竟出現約40公分的落差，引發日本政界議論。（共同社）
（中央社記者葉素萍台北21日電）2026年亞太經濟合作（APEC）經濟領袖會議落幕，資深涉外官員今天指出，中國主辦期間，從日本首相高市早苗專機舷梯落差，到為台日領袖代表安排具政治意涵的迎賓曲，一連串禮賓爭議，反映北京將多邊外交舞台作為政治操作場域，宛如現代版「晏嬰使楚」。
2026年亞太經濟合作（APEC）經濟領袖會議18、19日在中國深圳舉行。
資深涉外官員今天指出，現代外交禮賓是東道主展現國家形象的重要環節，但此次深圳APEC卻出現多項令人質疑的安排，包括高市早苗步出專機時，客梯車平台與機艙門之間出現約40公分落差，不僅涉及接待規格，更引發安全疑慮。
官員指出，依國際航空運輸協會（IATA）及國際標準化組織（ISO）相關規範，舷梯與機艙地板落差不應超過30公分。深圳機場卻出現約40公分落差，若非地勤專業不足，便可能涉及東道主刻意的政治羞辱。
官員指出，習近平上台後，類似「機場政治學」屢見不鮮，包括2016年杭州G20峰會，美國總統歐巴馬從專機機腹小門下機，以及近年時任美國國務卿布林肯訪中未獲紅毯接待等爭議；若將航空安全與外交禮賓作為政治報復工具，展現的並非大國威嚴，而是缺乏自信的焦躁。
官員指出，相較於機場接待，領袖晚宴迎賓曲的安排更值得玩味。中方為台灣領袖代表施振榮安排「高山青」，為日本首相高市早苗選用「昂首向前走」，背後可能隱含統戰與政治挑撥意味。
官員分析，「高山青」並非台灣原住民族傳統音樂，而是1949年電影插曲，反映當時漢人對原住民族的刻板想像；北京以此代表台灣，忽略台灣當代多元文化與主體性，凸顯其文化統戰思維。
至於日本的「昂首向前走」，官員指出，歌曲誕生於1960年代日本反對日美安保條約的時代背景，中方選擇此曲迎接與美國關係密切的日本領導人，中方自以為這暗諷了美日同盟的歷史心結，實則在國際場合展現極度失禮的外交輕佻。
官員並以「晏嬰使楚」為例指出，楚王昔日為羞辱齊國使臣晏嬰，刻意不開大門，反遭晏嬰以「使狗國者，從狗門入」回擊。北京此次種種禮賓安排，宛如楚王迎賓的現代翻版。
官員表示，回顧胡錦濤時代，過去中國舉辦北京奧運、上海世博，試圖透過大型國際活動展現和平崛起形象；如今卻在國際場合以細微禮賓安排傳遞政治訊息，反映了中國在「一人領導」體制下的文明衰退危機。
官員認為，東道主若藉禮賓安排矮化其他與會方，最終損害的並非對方尊嚴，而是自身國際形象與威信。（編輯：林克倫）1151121

SHANGHAI - China's imports of refined copper are poised to climb in 2027 following this year's rare drop, as persistent feedstock shortages curb domestic supply even as demand continues to rise, according to 15 industry analysts and traders polled by Reuters.
Higher imports will help the world's top consumer of the red metal used in construction, power grids and electric vehicles to regain some of the pricing power that has shifted to the US.
"China will have to import more refined copper next year because its refined production growth will remain very limited, constrained by persistently tight concentrate supply," said Nicholas Snowdon, head of metals and mining research at Mercuria, on the sidelines of this week's World Copper Conference Asia.
China's refined copper output this year is projected to grow at its slowest pace in decades, hampered by a prolonged concentrate shortage and reduced availability of scrap copper amid stricter enforcement of tax and invoicing policy.
Slowing supply growth and rapid inventory drawdowns have led to acute tightness in physical copper in China, where soaring spot premiums have compelled some traders to rush to import refined copper, including from the US.
"The gravitational pull of refined copper is now towards China, which has regained at least for now the pricing power that the US has dominated in the last two years," said Snowdon.
However, Raghav Jain, head of copper pricing at information provider Argus, expects a moderate recovery rather than a surge from the unusual weakness in 2026.
"We expect some normalisation of global cathode flows back towards China in 2027 if the US arbitrage remains less attractive," said Jain.
China's refined copper imports in the first 10 months of 2026 slid by 16% from the same time last year to 2.37-million tons, their lowest for the period since at least 2015, keeping total inbound shipments on track for an annual decline.
While tepid construction activity remains a drag, China's copper demand will grow by 4% in 2027 following this year's 2% increase, He Tianyu, analyst at consultancy CRU Group, told delegates on Wednesday.
"China's overall copper demand will keep rising over the next five years, but the structure is shifting with new growth drivers," said He, who expects the combined demand from power grids, data centres, renewables, energy storage and electric vehicles to make up 59% of the consumption increase in that period.
Chile's Codelco is offering refined copper to Chinese customers in 2027 at lower premiums than those charged this year to revive its sales in the world's biggest metals market.
However, US tariff policies remain uncertain.
Expectations for US tariffs on copper imports have upended global flows, with bumper US premiums over London Metal Exchange benchmark prices sucking in vast amounts of copper over the past two years, creating tightness elsewhere.
Washington has proposed a 15% tariff on refined copper imports starting in 2027, but it remains unclear whether such a duty will ultimately be implemented.
"The US midterm election result does not remove the US president's Section 232 authority, so tariff uncertainty has diminished rather than disappeared," said Argus' Jain.

content:
Fundraiser by Hillary Johnson : Hong Kong Photojournalism Trip
Hillary Johnson is organizing this fundraiser.
Hi everyone, my name is Hillary Johnson, and I’m a photographer living in Chicago, working all over the Midwest and in Hong Kong. I have two main threads to my photography practice, photojournalism and fine art.
Though it feels awkward, I confess, I’m pushing ahead because I need your help.
I’m going to Hong Kong on November 12 to cover the protest and the election of a new cabinet in Hong Kong.
You might wonder why bother giving money to me or why my voice particular needs to be added to this news event, or even why this matters to you at all. I hear that and I’ll do my best to answer your questions. I’ll also explain what you can do if you’re interested in helping out.
A little bit about me: in addition to being a photographer I’m also someone who studies a martial art called Ving Tsun. This art is extremely popular in Hong Kong for various reasons that I won’t go into right now but if you’re curious you can ask me and I’ll be happy to answer. It was the practice of this martial art that introduced me to my husband, Matt Johnson who runs a kung fu school here in Chicago.
This martial art has a code of ethics that involves being a good citizen, being humble, promoting peace, and standing up for what is right and protecting those who need protection from bullies and so forth.
I made my first trip to Hong Kong a couple of years ago and I’ve been back a few times since then. Though I’m someone who likes spend a lot of time in remote locations being quiet and letting the busyness of my mind and heart settle down, I felt 100% in love with the city of Hong Kong, it’s culture, it’s people, and of course with my kung fu family there.
As a result it has been difficult watching the news and worrying about this place I love so much and the people who live there.
My concern for all of this led me to do a story for the Chicago Reader.
Here's a link to that: https://www.chicagoreader.com/chicago/photos-hong-kong-protest-freedom/Content?oid=73815391
I’m extremely grateful to the reader for giving me the time and space that it did. I made all the photographs, did all the interviews, and wrote all the text with guidance from the amazing Reader staff. In the process of working on that story I began to see, that much that was going on in Hong Kong seems to not quite be making it into the news. This made me want to go to Hong Kong and do more.
The stories we have been seeing her only the tip of the iceberg. I’m interested in the stories of ordinary people, their everyday life, and what they do.
How do they support each other in the midst of such extreme difficulty?
I want to understand the impact of what’s happening in this interaction between the Beijing mainland Chinese government in the city of Hong Kong in the Hong Kong people.
It’s interesting that Hong Kong has roots and connections stretching out from the city, all over the globe. While working on the story I’ve met many people here in Chicago who have a deep connections to Hong Kong.
I want to go and photograph an interview to help amplify the voices of those people not being heard as much as they might be.
Why do the events Hong Kong matter to you wherever you might live?
Number one. Hong Kong people are simply asking for fundamental human rights to be recognized.
Number two. The Hong Kong people are asking for the promises made by the Chinese government to be kept.
Number three. The Hong Kong people want their freedom.
All people everywhere around the world want their fundamental human rights, they want promises to be kept and they want freedom.
If we all look into our own hearts I believe we will see this truth is self evident.
What’s happening in Hong Kong matters to all of us, because all of us want the same things; freedom, respect- both given and received, dignity, and agency.
Further, for those of us living in other parts of the world, if we think that what’s happening in Hong Kong cannot happen to us wherever it is that we happen to live, I think if you forgive me, that view is naïve.
The road to tyranny is a slippery slope.
First one right is eroded, then another, then another.
For this trip to Hong Kong all the groundwork is in place.
Because of the network being built up over the years and as a result of my recent work, there are people on the ground in Hong Kong ready to help with making connections, translation, safety and getting around and so forth.
My intention is to get to Hong Kong do my work at the photographer and then do my best to get those stories out into the world so that everyone can know what is going on.
But I need help with the expenses.
Airfare and hotel around $2100-2400 depending on flight details
Transportation in Hong Kong When the MTR is shut down taxis may be necessary - estimating maybe $300
Money to pay translators and other fixtures and facilitators estimating $300-500
A laptop to process photos while I’m there so I can send them out to editors at various news outlets - around $200-300
I’m hoping to raise $3500. to cover all of that as well as some of my bills while I’m away so that the lights and heat are still on when I return home.
Addition I’ll provide links to news outlets as well as the story I did for the reader so that you can get more information about the situation over there.
I’ll also link or attach a video that I made about the story.
As things when I’m planning to offer in addition to publicly thinking everyone who supports this is the creation of a private Facebook group where I post updates photos and video from my time in Hong Kong.
This content will be exclusively for anyone who supports this trip.
I’m excited to announce that someone already made a first donation of $500 before even launched this campaign which let me adjust the amount needed to $3500
Honestly I wasn’t even planning on doing this but so many people said to me that they wanted to support the trip and believe in the mission of supporting truth and openness and democracy, that I pushed past my own discomfort and jumped in.
I want to thank all of you in advance for your support and help.
Please know that even if you can’t donate money to this trip, I’d be very grateful for your repeated sharing of the campaign. We all know how this works, and whether we like it or not it requires a certain diligence. A lather rinse and repeat process.
For those of you who can donate, please know how grateful I am for your support. And that no donation is too small or too large.
Again my heartfelt thanks. You should know also that I’ve never felt more sense of mission or purpose in going after story. This has my whole heart and I hope very much but I’ll find out that’s for publishing material of the world to know what is going on in Hong Kong at this critical time in history.
As a final note, I want to add that one of the things I’ve heard lately, is that China may be starting to crack down on the practice of martial arts.
This truly is history repeating itself. This happened during the period of conflict between the Ming and Qing dynasty.
It happened again during the cultural revolution.
And now it’s happening once again.
Why does China always clamp down on martial artists?
Because martial artists, as part of their training, learn how important it is to stand up and fight when it’s necessary. The core of traditional martial arts is about values that respect all people and offer protection to those who need it.
I like to think that with my camera I’m bringing the spirit of kung fu, of the Ving Tsun I love, to my practice using my camera to help protect and defend those in Hong Kong.
I hope that you’ll join me in this fight.
Let me know what questions you may have.
Happy to try my best to answer.
May all be safe, happy, strong and at ease. ❤️

content:
2026年11月21日，中華民國陸委會主委邱垂正出席政大國關中心主辦的第六屆「理解中（共）國統戰」工作坊，並就「兩岸關係的現在與未來」進行專題演講。（陸委會臉書提供）
【大紀元2026年11月21日訊】（大紀元記者鍾元台灣報導）中華民國陸委會主委邱垂正指出，近年來中共對台採取軟硬兩手與複合性施壓策略，將政治目的強加於兩岸交流互動之中，提醒國人留意中共統戰手法及意圖。
陸委會臉書發文，邱垂正20日出席政大國關中心主辦的第六屆「理解中（共）國統戰」工作坊，並就「兩岸關係的現在與未來」進行專題演講。
邱垂正與現場學者專家及研究人員交流當前台海情勢及兩岸關係發展，並肯定學界長期致力於解析中共統戰手法與模式，協助社會大眾提升識別能力與防衛意識。
邱垂正於演講中說明近期中國大陸與國際重要政經情勢，並分析近年來中共對台採取軟硬兩手與複合性施壓策略。
他指出，中共一方面持續進行軍事威脅、外交打壓、經濟脅迫、法律戰及認知作戰，企圖片面改變台海現狀；另一方面則透過「海峽論壇」等統戰平台，釋出片面宣稱的「惠台」措施，將政治目的強加於兩岸交流互動之中，提醒國人及與會學者留意中共統戰手法及意圖。
面對中共步步進逼的統戰威脅，邱垂正強調，政府將秉持「四個堅持」與「四個不變」，全力落實賴清德總統提出的「和平四大支柱行動方案」，積極強化國防力量、建構經濟安全及全社會防衛韌性，並持續深化與國際民主夥伴的合作，共同維護台海及區域的和平穩定。
第六屆「理解中（共）國統戰」工作坊由政大國關中心主辦，場次包括「國際大統戰」「對港澳台統戰策略」「民族、符號與敘事」「宗教統戰」及圓桌論壇等。

content:
Fundraiser by Hong Kong Forum : 自由雕塑公園之『香港地』香港抗爭者雕像金屬牌匾 及 新壁畫
Hong Kong Forum for Hong Kong Forum Los Angeles
Hong Kong Forum for Hong Kong Forum Los Angeles
Hong Kong Forum is organizing this fundraiser to benefit Hong Kong Forum Los Angeles.
Hong Kong Forum for Hong Kong Forum Los Angeles
5年過去了，彷彿一切烽煙已經在時間中沈沒，然而有些人仍然選擇不去遺忘。
Five years have passed since Hong Konger's last attempt to maintain their freedom, and it seems that all dust has settled. However, some people still choose not to forget.
經過多方努力，我們在Yermo的自由雕塑公園（Liberty Sculpture Park）建立起了香港地，用藝術去銘記香港人的意志不滅。
After many efforts, we have established Hong Kong Corner in the Liberty Sculpture Park in Yermo, using art to remember the unyielding will of the Hong Kongers.
香港地的維護和創作需要長期的投入，我們亟需你的支持。不論捐款多少，都代表著你對香港所出的一分力。
The maintenance and creation of Yermo's "Hong Kong Corner" requires long-term investment, and we urgently need your support. Any donation, no matter the amount, represents your contribution to the undying spirit of Hong Kongers.
We hope to meet in a free Hong Kong someday.
Donation serves 3 main purposes.
1. 現時香港地有四件展品，沙漠氣候極端，冬寒夏焰，烈日風沙，我們要定期維修，提供防曬材料予連儂牆， 令他們可以日久維新。
1. Currently, Hong Kong Corner has four exhibits. We need to perform regular maintenance for some of the art works and provide sun & water protection sealants in the harsh desert weather condition.
2. 香港抗爭者的雕像現時沒有任何解釋。 在我們維修的過程當中，經常見到美國本地人到訪，但他們對於2019抗爭一事並不了清楚。希望可以籌款建立一塊金屬牌匾， 刻上中英文描述，令到到訪者了解究竟發生了什麼事。
2. The statues of Hong Kong Protesters currently have no explanations. During our maintenance work, we often see local Americans visiting, but they are not familiar with the 2019 protests. We hope to raise funds to establish a metal plaque with descriptions in both Chinese and English to help visitors understand what happened.
3. 自由雕塑公園的創辦人陳維明老師亦為香港地建立了新牆，我們希望可以籌款聘請來自香港的專業藝術家，以壁畫描繪出香港的景況。
3. Mr. Chen Wei Ming, the art creator of Liberty Sculpture Park, has also built a new wall for Hong Kong Land. We hope to raise funds to pay for the expenses of hiring a professional artist from Hong Kong to depict the situation in Hong Kong with a mural.

中新社台北11月21日电 外交部周六表示，台湾将提供首期2000万美元帮助马绍尔群岛建立中小企业信用担保计划。
外交部在一份新闻稿中表示，外交部长林佳龙和马绍尔群岛财政部长戴维·保罗周五在两国建交28周年之际在台北签署了该机制的谅解备忘录。

外交部表示，初始资金可能会根据需求增加。
林说，该协议将扩大双边合作，超越机构之间的交流，包括直接的财政支持，帮助增强马绍尔群岛的经济弹性并实现产业多元化。
保罗感谢台湾长期以来的支持，称该计划将有助于鼓励私人投资、创造就业机会并加强岛国的经济自力更生。
外交部表示，双方还讨论了两国在能源安全、清洁能源、渔业加工、航空运输和金融科技等领域的潜在合作。

Marshall Islands Finance Minister David Paul (left) and Taiwan's Foreign Minister Lin Chia-lung (right). Photo courtesy of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs
Taipei, Nov. 21 (CNA) Taiwan will provide an initial US$20 million to help the Marshall Islands establish a credit guarantee program for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA) said Saturday.
Foreign Minister Lin Chia-lung (林佳龍) and Marshall Islands Finance Minister David Paul signed a memorandum of understanding on the mechanism in Taipei on Friday, the 28th anniversary of diplomatic ties between the two countries, MOFA said in a press release.
Drawing on Taiwan's experience with SME financing and credit guarantee programs, the program will help businesses in the Marshall Islands obtain loans by reducing lending risks for financial institutions.
The initial funding may be increased depending on demand, MOFA said.
Lin said the agreement would expand bilateral cooperation beyond exchanges between institutions to include direct financial support, helping strengthen the Marshall Islands' economic resilience and diversify its industries.
Paul thanked Taiwan for its longstanding support, saying the program would help encourage private investment, create jobs and strengthen the island nation's economic self-reliance.
The two sides also discussed potential cooperation in energy security, clean energy, fisheries processing, air links and financial technology, MOFA said.

content:
The True Assets of Life: Discovering Happiness That Never Betrays Us, Mon, Nov 23, 2026, 8:00 PM | Meetup
The True Assets of Life: Discovering Happiness That Never Betrays Us
Hosted by Nadia B. and Lori Z.
Join a session to learn more; make sure your camera is on when you enter our zoom room until we greet each other. Our classes are free for the first 3 sessions. After that, we hope you offer a contribution to help us sustain these classes; the Zoom passcode is 426646
What is the ultimate purpose of life? Is it to accumulate wealth, maintain good health, build meaningful relationships, or enjoy the comforts and pleasures that life has to offer? These things certainly bring us happiness, but Buddhism invites us to look more deeply. Are they reliable sources of happiness? Can they remain with us forever? And is there a kind of happiness that will never betray or abandon us?
According to Buddhism, the ultimate purpose of life is to attain lasting happiness—a happiness that cannot be taken away by aging, sickness, death, or separation from the people and things we cherish. We often experience joy when things go our way, but that happiness can quickly turn into suffering when circumstances change. We lose our health, financial security, loved ones, or possessions. Even our most treasured relationships are subject to impermanence. The Buddha taught that we live in a world where suffering is unavoidable as long as we depend on temporary things for our happiness.
### The Illusion of Possession: The Story of the Miser
An Aesop's fable about a miser offers a powerful lesson about our attachment to material possessions.
The miser sold everything he owned, converted his wealth into a single lump of gold, and buried it in a secret place. Every day, he visited the hiding place just to look at his treasure. One day, a worker discovered the gold, dug it up, and stole it. When the miser returned and found the empty hole, he was devastated. He wept bitterly until someone suggested that he replace the gold with a stone and simply imagine that his treasure was still there. After all, even when he possessed the gold, he had never actually used it.
The story raises an interesting question: If we never make use of something, do we truly possess it?
One participant compared the miser's situation to worshipping an idol. The gold had become so important that it occupied the center of his heart and mind, even though it served no practical purpose. Another participant observed that having and not having the gold were essentially the same because the miser had never used it.
We may find this story amusing, but don't we sometimes behave in similar ways?
We accumulate money, possessions, and other forms of security because we are afraid of losing them. We purchase insurance, build financial reserves, and take precautions to protect what we have. There is nothing inherently wrong with being responsible, but Buddhism encourages us to examine where we place our trust.
We often take our health, family, friendships, and financial stability for granted. Only when we lose them do we realize how much we depended on them. We may not fully appreciate our health until we become ill, or recognize the importance of someone until we are separated from that person.
In Buddhist terminology, this reliance on something as a source of happiness can be understood as a form of faith. Faith does not necessarily mean believing in a supernatural being. We also place our faith in money, health, relationships, and other people. Without realizing it, we make these things the foundation of our happiness.
But if all these things are impermanent, can any of them truly provide everlasting security?
Another important asset we often overlook is time.
We all receive twenty-four hours each day, regardless of our financial circumstances or social status. Yet time is perhaps the most precious and limited resource we possess. Unlike money, once time has passed, we cannot recover it.
Buddha's teaching on the brevity of human life offers a particularly striking perspective. When asked how long human life lasts, one disciple suggested that it was like a week. Another compared it to the time it takes to enjoy a meal. But Buddha was not satisfied with either answer. A third disciple explained that life lasts only between one breath and the next. If we cannot inhale after exhaling, or exhale after inhaling, our life comes to an end.
From this perspective, life is not something we possess for decades. All we truly have is this present moment.
We often behave as though we have unlimited time, postponing important decisions, meaningful conversations, and personal growth. Yet the future we imagine so far away soon becomes the present. Therefore, Buddhism encourages us to become more conscious of how we use our time and the causes we create today.
### Trust: An Asset More Valuable Than Money
If money, health, relationships, and even time are impermanent, what is the most reliable asset we can cultivate during this lifetime?
A second story, about a young scholar and a little girl, provides an inspiring answer.
One day, the scholar encountered a poorly dressed little girl crying beside the road. She had accidentally broken a jar that she had borrowed to buy milk for her seriously ill parent. Frightened that she would be scolded, she did not know what to do.
The young scholar wanted to help her, but he was poor and had no money. He promised to meet her at the same place the following day and give her enough money to replace the jar.
The next day, however, he received an urgent message. A wealthy man had arrived in town and was interested in sponsoring his work. Meeting this potential benefactor could transform his financial future. Nevertheless, doing so would mean breaking his promise to the little girl.
The young scholar chose to keep his promise. He declined the opportunity to meet the wealthy man and asked him to return another day.
Initially offended, the wealthy man eventually learned why the scholar had declined the meeting. Deeply impressed by his integrity, he became his strongest supporter.
The lesson is profound: Trust is an asset more valuable than money.
Money may come and go, but trust is the foundation upon which meaningful relationships and lasting opportunities are built. Even if we temporarily lose money by keeping our promises, we preserve something far more valuable—our integrity and the confidence others place in us.
Trust takes considerable time and consistent effort to develop, but it can disappear in an instant. Every promise we keep, every honest action we take, and every responsibility we fulfill becomes a cause for building trust.
The story reminds us that we should never become slaves to money, sacrificing our principles for financial gain. Rather, we should become people worthy of trust. Promises that cannot be kept should not be made, and once we make a promise, we should do our best to honor it.
### Creating the Causes for Lasting Happiness
The foundation of Buddhism is the law of cause and effect. The causes we create today shape the effects we experience tomorrow. Our future is not disconnected from our present; it is an extension of it.
If we continue creating the same causes, we can expect similar results. If we live in confusion and suffering without seeking a solution, we are likely to carry that darkness into the future. Simply leaving this world does not automatically transform our inner condition.
Therefore, something transformative must happen while we are alive. This is the significance of attaining salvation in this life. Buddhism teaches that when we attain this transformation, we can also be assured of salvation in the afterlife.
The ultimate purpose of life is not merely to become wealthy, successful, healthy, or respected. These may be worthwhile aspects of our everyday lives, but they are not the ultimate destination. The deeper question is whether we are moving toward genuine happiness and liberation from suffering.
We have the rare opportunity, as human beings, to reflect on our existence, examine our minds, understand cause and effect, and consciously create the causes for a better future.
Ultimately, the most important question is not simply, "What do I possess?" but rather, "Where am I placing my faith, and what kind of person am I becoming?"
Material possessions may disappear. Health may decline. Relationships may change. Time inevitably passes. But by cultivating integrity, keeping our promises, developing trust, and seeking the deeper truth of life, we begin to discover something far more valuable than temporary fortune.
Buddhism encourages us to seek a happiness that does not depend on favorable circumstances—a happiness that will not betray us, even when life changes.
Perhaps the greatest wealth is not what we have accumulated, but the wisdom to understand what truly matters and the courage to create the causes for lasting happiness.

（中央社記者呂佳蓉台北21日電）中國北京電影學院18日正式成立馬克思主義學院。北京電影學院表示，要把馬克思主義的旗幟在藝術教育的陣地上高高舉起；中共北京市委教育工委副書記張宇蕾說，希望學校強化「黨的全面領導」。
根據北京電影學院在微信公眾號消息，北京電影學院馬克思主義學院在星期三（11月18日）正式成立，並稱「從延安電影團一路走來，北京電影學院始終堅守立德樹人初心使命，為黨育人、為國育才，把馬克思主義的旗幟，在藝術教育的陣地上高高舉起」。
中共北京市委教育工委副書記張宇蕾等人出席成立大會。張宇蕾表示，馬克思主義學院的成立是學校加強黨的全面領導的重要舉措。她希望學校強化黨的全面領導，築牢馬院建設政治保障，打造藝術院校馬克思主義理論研究高地。
北京電影學院院長扈強在大會上介紹馬克思主義學院工作方案，稱學院要堅持政治引領，突出影視特色。
成立大會後，中國國防科技大學思政課指導教師朱容瑢主講馬克思主義學院第一堂課。朱容瑢的祖母是朱楓，朱楓是1949年隨中共地下組織來台，1950年因「吳石案」遭國民政府槍決的中共情報員。
北京電影學院表示，朱容瑢藉由講述朱楓的過往，講述「紅色家風傳承與信仰力量」，呈現一場「有特殊感染力的思政課」。（編輯：陳鎧妤）1151121

Fundraiser by The Lantos Foundation : Legal Defense for Hong Kong Democracy Activists
The Lantos Foundation for Tom Lantos Foundation for Human Rights & Justice
The Lantos Foundation for Tom Lantos Foundation for Human Rights & Justice
The Lantos Foundation is organizing this fundraiser to benefit Tom Lantos Foundation for Human Rights & Justice.
The Lantos Foundation for Tom Lantos Foundation for Human Rights & Justice
The Lantos Foundation for Human Rights & Justice stands with the people of Hong Kong on the front lines of the fight for freedom & democracy.
Courageous Hong Kong democracy activists have been protesting for months against a dangerous Chinese extradition bill that would have undermined their independence and freedom. Though the bill has now been formally withdrawn, the fight is not over. Since June, thousands of protesters have been attacked and injured by police and mainland gangs and over 1,100 people have been detained. Those arrested for peacefully protesting have been charged with offenses that could put them in jail for many years.
Hong Kong Democracy protesters have won the first huge victory in the court of public opinion, but the next victories will need to be won in the courts of law.
Just a few months ago, the Lantos Foundation was proud to give our highest award to the most recognizable leader of the democracy movement – Joshua Wong. While such leadership is important, all of the brave democracy crusaders deserve more than our admiration. We must equip them to defend themselves against the crushing apparatus of the Chinese communist state. This legal defense fund aims to support Joshua and his compatriots as they defend themselves against false accusations that could land them in prison for years to come.
Our hope is that we can match their courage and determination in the form of financial support that will ensure they have fair representation. It is critical that the rule of law be upheld at this pivotal moment in Hong Kong's history. The eyes of the world may be on Hong Kong, but the eyes of history will be on those of us enjoying our own freedom and democracy - let us match our words and good wishes with the resources to defend those on the front lines of this fight for freedom.
These legal defense funds will be officially disbursed through the Lantos Foundation's Front Line Fund grant program.

content:
股市波动之际台湾进一步收紧卖空 - 焦点台湾
股市波动之际台湾进一步收紧卖空
要激活文字转语音服务，请首先同意以下隐私政策。
中新社台北11月21日电 台湾金融监督管理委员会(FSC)周六宣布，由于人工智能(AI)相关股票的全球波动，台湾股市近几个交易日遭受重创，因此进一步收紧卖空限制。
FSC 在一份声明中表示，已禁止卖空前一交易日价格下跌的股票，这是该委员会自 2015 年以来首次实施如此全面的限制。
最新措施收紧了周四宣布的限制，禁止卖空前一交易日下跌 3.5% 或以上的股票。
FSC表示，新规则旨在维护有序交易和市场稳定。
证监会还将卖空的最低保证金要求从130%提高到150%，要求投资者提供更多的抵押品。
FSC 表示，新规定将于周一生效。
最新的限制措施出台之前，台湾证券交易所基准指数周五暴跌 2,393.60 点，跌幅 6.23%，收于 36,033.29 点，为近七个月来的最低收盘水平。这是有记录以来第三大单节失分。
由于人们对全球人工智能行业前景的担忧日益加剧，台交所指数从 10 月 6 日创下的盘中高点 49,968.92 点，下跌 14,230.24 点，跌幅为 28.48%，至周五盘中低点 35,738.68 点。
周六上午，总理卓荣泰会见了包括该委员会在内的经济和金融机构负责人，并指示他们制定稳定市场的措施，随后金融服务委员会宣布了这些措施。
金管会还决定暂停接受证券公司在台湾证券交易所和经营场外交易市场的台北证券交易所发行认沽权证的申请。
证监会表示，将继续鼓励上市公司回购自己的股票。
它还呼吁金融机构和其他贷款机构暂停证券借贷，并对已借出的股票提前收回或到期不再续借。
FSC表示将密切关注快速变化的全球金融市场和当地市场状况，并相应调整其稳定措施。
自11月6日起，规模达5000亿新台币（约合151.8亿美元）的国家金融稳定基金管理委员会已获授权干预市场，而金管会此后也逐步出台了遏制卖空的措施。

Taiwan further tightens short-selling amid stock market volatility
To activate the text-to-speech service, please first agree to the privacy policy below.
Taipei, Nov. 21 (CNA) Taiwan's Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) announced Saturday that it had further tightened short-selling restrictions after the country's stock market suffered heavy losses in recent sessions amid global volatility in artificial intelligence (AI)-related stocks.
In a statement, the FSC said it had prohibited short-selling of stocks whose prices fell in the previous trading session, marking the first time since 2015 that the commission had imposed such a blanket restriction.
The latest measure tightens a restriction announced Thursday that prohibited short-selling of stocks that had fallen 3.5 percent or more in the previous trading session.
The new rule is aimed at maintaining orderly trading and market stability, the FSC said.
The commission also raised the minimum margin requirement for short-selling from 130 percent to 150 percent, requiring investors to provide more collateral.
The new rules will take effect Monday, the FSC said.
The latest restrictions came after the Taiex, the Taiwan Stock Exchange's benchmark index, plunged 2,393.60 points, or 6.23 percent, to close at 36,033.29 Friday, its lowest closing level in nearly seven months. It was the third-largest single-session point loss on record.
From an intraday record high of 49,968.92 points on Oct. 6, the Taiex had fallen 14,230.24 points, or 28.48 percent, to an intraday low of 35,738.68 Friday amid growing concerns about the outlook for the global AI industry.
The FSC announced the measures after Premier Cho Jung-tai (卓榮泰) met with heads of economic and financial agencies, including the commission, Saturday morning and instructed them to devise measures to stabilize the market.
The FSC also decided to suspend acceptance of applications from securities firms seeking to issue put warrants for listing on the Taiwan Stock Exchange and the Taipei Exchange, which operates the over-the-counter market.
The commission said it would continue to encourage listed companies to buy back their own shares.
It also called on financial institutions and other lenders to suspend securities lending and, for shares already lent out, to recall the shares early or refrain from renewing the loans when they mature.
The FSC said it would closely monitor rapidly changing global financial markets and local market conditions and adjust its stabilization measures accordingly.
The management committee of the NT$500 billion (US$15.18 billion) National Financial Stabilization Fund has been authorized to intervene in the market since Nov. 6, while the FSC has gradually introduced measures to curb short-selling since then.

Taiwan welcomes 4 allies' support for inclusion in U.N. climate talks
To activate the text-to-speech service, please first agree to the privacy policy below.
Taipei, Nov. 21 (CNA) Taiwan's government on Saturday thanked four diplomatic allies for supporting its participation in global climate governance at a recent United Nations climate conference, saying their backing reflected recognition of Taiwan's ability to contribute to international efforts.
The four allies -- Guatemala, Belize, St. Vincent and the Grenadines, and Paraguay -- voiced support for Taiwan during the high-level segment of the 31st Conference of the Parties to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (COP31), held Nov. 17-18 in Türkiye.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA) said in a press release that the countries supported Taiwan's participation in global climate mechanisms and recognized its efforts in carbon pricing, greenhouse gas emissions reduction, climate adaptation and clean technology.
Guatemalan Environment Minister Edwin Josué Castellanos López said Taiwan's efforts in carbon pricing, emissions reduction and climate adaptation demonstrated its commitment to climate neutrality, MOFA said.
St. Vincent and the Grenadines said an energy transition could not be considered just or inclusive if it left small island developing states behind or excluded willing partners, according to the ministry.
In a written statement, Paraguay said Taiwan had made important contributions to climate change mitigation and adaptation, technological development and international cooperation, and should be allowed to participate in the conference's activities.
MOFA thanked the four allies for speaking up for Taiwan at an important international forum, saying the country had gained experience and made measurable progress in emissions reduction, climate adaptation, clean technology and sustainable development.

中新网台北11月21日电 台湾女子反曲射箭队21日在中国杭州举行的2026年亚洲射箭杯金牌赛中直落三盘不敌东道主，夺得银牌。
台湾队由郭紫颖、李采璇和王芯柔组成，他们也与台湾射箭运动员林恩绮一起参加个人项目。
个人赛结束后，郭、李、王联手在四分之一决赛击败澳大利亚，在半决赛击败韩国，晋级决赛对阵中国队。
然而，台湾队却在五局三胜的比赛中，与中国队的李木子、沈佳雯、仲绮轩遭遇三连败。
台湾队以54-56输掉首盘，王俊凯第一箭只拿下7分，郭晶晶拿下8分。
第二盘，双方弓箭手各得一箭7分，台湾队以49-57落败。
第三盘台湾队有所进步，避免了低分，但中国队保持领先，以57-55拿下第一盘，以6-0锁定胜局。
作为台湾队最年轻的队员，王健林在金牌争夺战中表现不佳。
尽管她在三盘比赛中用六支箭两次击中10分内环，但她也打出了两支七杆和一支八杆，最终平均每支箭得到8.50分。
台湾队平均每支箭得分为 8.78 分，而中国队为 9.44 分。
中华台北射箭协会秘书长林政贤在评价球队的表现时表示，杭州射箭亚洲杯为射箭运动员提供了宝贵的经验。
他表示，在金牌比赛中感受到压力是很正常的，最重要的是在下一场国际比赛之前吸取经验教训。

Taiwan wins silver after falling to China in Archery Asia Cup women's recurve final
To activate the text-to-speech service, please first agree to the privacy policy below.
Taipei, Nov. 21 (CNA) Taiwan's women's recurve archery team won silver at the 2026 Archery Asia Cup in Hangzhou, China on Saturday, after losing to the host nation in three straight sets in the gold-medal match.
The Taiwanese team comprised Kuo Tzu-ying (郭紫穎), Li Cai-xuan (李采璇) and Wang Xin-ron (王芯柔), who also competed in the individual event alongside fellow Taiwanese archer Lin En-chi (林恩綺).
After the individual event, Kuo, Li and Wang teamed up to defeat Australia in the quarterfinals and South Korea in the semifinals, advancing to the final against China.
However, Taiwan struggled against China's Li Muzi (李木子), Shen Jiawen (沈佳雯) and Zhong Qixuan (仲綺璇), losing three straight sets in the best-of-five contest.
Taiwan lost the opening set 54-56, with Wang scoring just seven points on her first arrow and Kuo scoring eight.
Both archers then scored seven points with an arrow each in the second set, which Taiwan lost 49-57.
Taiwan improved in the third set, avoiding low-scoring shots, but China maintained its lead to take the set 57-55 and seal a 6-0 victory.
Wang, the youngest member of the Taiwanese team, struggled in the gold-medal match.
Although she hit the 10-point inner ring twice with her six arrows across the three sets, she also scored two sevens and an eight, finishing with an average of 8.50 points per arrow.
Taiwan averaged 8.78 points per arrow, compared with China's 9.44.
Commenting on the team's performance, Chinese Taipei Archery Association Secretary-General Lin Cheng-hsien (林政賢) said the Archery Asia Cup in Hangzhou had provided valuable experience for the archers.
He said it was normal to feel pressure during a gold-medal match and that the most important thing was to learn from the experience ahead of the next international tournament.

（中央社記者呂佳蓉台北21日電）華為常務董事長余承東20日在一場記者會上介紹L3自動駕駛路測時，宣稱「開車是可以睡覺的，別睡死過去就行了」，言論引起風波。他於記者會結束僅一小時後，馬上在微博發文說，目前仍處於L2輔助駕駛時代，駕駛務必專心開車、不能睡覺。
鴻蒙智行享界V8記者會20日在北京舉行，首款大型MPV「享界V8」正式上市，不過記者會上的焦點落在余承東的爭議言論上。
余承東在記者會上說，享界V8率先開啟時速120公里L3跨城高速路測，接著說「L3自動駕駛來了以後，開車就不用摸方向盤了，開車是可以睡覺的，別睡死過去就行了。20秒給你喚醒就可以了」，表示系統遇極端情況，會透過安全帶收緊與喇叭喚醒駕駛。
這番言論引起中國網友批評，有人說「依舊誇大宣傳」、「睡覺可不可以在家裡」、「為甚麼那麼執著於開車睡覺」，還有人批批評「符合現行法律規定嗎？大嘴一張，人命關天」。
隨著輿論迅速發酵，他於一小時後發文澄清，「有幾句話講的不準確」，說明V8目前開放使用的是L2輔助駕駛，L3硬體雖具備但尚未開放，呼籲大家握好方向盤，開車不能睡覺。
有相關報導指出，這並非余承東首次出現言論爭議。2025年5月，有網友發布影片表示，余承東駕駛問界M8時，頭部低垂近20秒且未握方向盤，質疑他「開車睡覺」。同年7月，余承東才回應稱「我當時是在低頭看手機」，並稱事後已主動前往公安局自首，接受罰款。（編輯：周慧盈）1151121

content:
韩联社首尔11月21日电 【要闻回顾】BLACKPINK成员Jennie获两项格莱美提名；韩国演员高庚杓承认醉驾并宣布暂停演艺活动；防弹少年团开启世巡“阿里郎”亚洲及澳大利亚站；NCT DREAM正规六辑销量破百万大关。
女团BLACKPINK成员Jennie凭借与澳大利亚迷幻摇滚乐队Tame Impala合作的歌曲《Dracula》，获得第69届格莱美奖最佳流行对唱/组合表演（最佳流行合作）与年度制作两项提名。其中，年度制作属于格莱美四大通类奖项之一。《Dracula》原曲于去年10月首次发行，今年2月推出Jennie参与的混音版后迅速走红，最高冲至美国公告牌百强单曲榜第三位。
此外，韩国女团IVE和KiiiKiii分别凭借《BANG BANG》和《404 (New Era)》，入围本届新设的“最佳亚洲流行音乐表演”奖。
演员高庚杓15日在其社交账号发文，就醉酒驾车引发交通事故一事道歉，并宣布暂停演艺活动。高庚杓于14日凌晨3时30分许在首尔麻浦区东桥洞酒后驾车，撞上环卫清洁车，当时他的血液酒精浓度达到吊销驾照标准（0.08%及以上）。
高庚杓出演的综艺节目《闲着干嘛呢》《第六感：B Side》《惊人的星期六》有待播出，他出演的《宝剑魔法》第二季和《大逃脱：都市怪谈》分别将于本月29日和下月2日上线。
防弹少年团（BTS）世巡“阿里郎”的亚洲及澳大利亚站演出19日拉开帷幕，整体计划在9座城市共举办26场演出。其中，亚洲站将于11月19日、21日、22日率先在高雄开唱，随后陆续登陆曼谷、吉隆坡、新加坡、雅加达、香港和布拉干，在7座城市共举办21场演唱会；澳大利亚站则将于明年2月在墨尔本和悉尼共举办5场演出。
11月21日的高雄第二场演出和12月29日的雅加达第三场演出将在全球80多个国家和地区的各大院线转播。
经纪公司SM娱乐16日表示，旗下男团NCT DREAM第六张正规专辑《DREAM AFTER DREAM》销量突破百万大关。
《DREAM AFTER DREAM》于本月9日发行。以韩国唱片销售统计网站Hanteo Chart统计为准，该专辑首周销量达到100.25万张，排名周榜第一。这是NCT DREAM自首张正规专辑以来，连续第11张销量突破百万张。该专辑在发行后席卷韩国主要音乐排行榜，还在QQ音乐和酷狗音乐排行榜取得亮眼成绩。
